To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
zinc absorption was not affected by phytase, but zinc retention and bone zinc were increased.
zinc absorption and retention were not affected by supplemental zinc, 1,25-DHCC, phytase, or 1,25- DHCC and phytase in corn-soybean-meal diets.

1) phytase increased zinc absorption in zinc- deficient birds and increased zinc retention in zinc-replete birds; 2) zinc retention was increased when 1,25(OH)2D3 was fed with phytase; and 3) phytase did not increase plasma zinc or alkaline phosphatases in zinc-deficient chicks.
In summary, our research is concerned with
determining the effect of 1, 25-dihydrocholecalciferols and phytase supplementation on zinc utilization in the chick.
the effects of dietary phytate phosphorous and vitamin D on zinc utilization.
the effect of 1, 25-dihydroxycalciferol and phytic acid on the availability of zinc in broilers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
phytase does not increase zinc utilization, and the effect of 1, 25-(OH) 2D3 on zinc utilization is not consistent.

the results of the experiments conducted with broiler chicks indicate that the addition of phytase or vitamin D3 or both to a corn-soy based diet can increase the absorption of phosphorus, and that this increase can be additive.
the effects of 1, 25-(OH) 2D3 on zinc utilization were inconsistent and that the effects of phytic acid on zinc utilization were not demonstrated.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
phytase and vitamin D3 can be used synergistically to improve the utilization of phytate-P in corn-soybean diets.
1,25(OH)(2)D3 increased bone zinc and that phytase plus 25(OH)(3)D3 increased zinc absorption and bone zinc.
phytate phosphorous utilization was improved by 1,2,5-(OH)2-D3 and phytases, but the effects on zinc utilization were inconsistent.
The main takeaway from our work is that
phytase is a very important enzyme in poultry nutrition.
phytase can be used to improve zinc retention in the presence of 1, 25-(OH) 2 D3.
the use of phytase and/or vitamin D3 may be useful for increasing phosphorus utilization, but that the use of these additives may not be useful for increasing zinc utilization.
